title: הספרה שפותחת שליש מכל המספרים בעולם
summary: Benford's law: in real-world lists ~30.1% of numbers start with 1 and 4.6% with 9 — Newcomb's dirty log-table pages (1881), Benford's 20,229 numbers (1938), why multiplicative growth and the log ruler give the staircase (a town growing 10%/yr spends ~7 years from 1,000 to 2,000 but ~1 from 9,000 to 10,000), which lists don't obey (heights, draws), and Nigrini's fraud detector catching Arizona's Wayne Nelson (18 of 23 fake checks began with 8 or 9).
